objective: One original chunk256 tangent attempt from the captured F77 returned fields. Locate the first actual unsupported constructor/normalized-pair/temporary predicate and its producer source location, then connect it to all three saved DD tangent fields and the original total_tangent rejection. No force reevaluation or production-core change.

established_facts.selector_fact_not_root_cause: Saved near flags are all true, but G_hi max exceeds the literal 2^-64 bound and G_lo is zero. Thus the whole-batch tiny-product selector is false for these saved words. This identifies a branch, not the failing primitive or component. No selector/DD function was executed during design.
established_facts.field_order: _finish_tangent visits total_tangent, material_tangent, regularization_tangent and stops at the first original failed predicate. Original details total_tangent therefore do not establish that the two component tensors are supported.
established_facts.unresolved: No primitive, element, directional/force entry or offending high/low word has been observed yet. No root cause or repair is asserted.

single_attempt_recipe: Freeze a new independent diagnostic source/protocol and fresh output. Hash observation, both NPZ archives and actual saved source capsules/current matching sources before importing. Recheck all17/25 dtype/shape/C-byte declarations and raw split-state SHA; reuse captured grad/hessian/weights/points/lam/mu/kr exactly. No TMCModel/Project or operators reconstruction.

Import the exact source-bound NumPy tangent implementation in one process. Directly invoke _tangent_chunked(cached_fields, saved_ops, saved_lam, saved_mu, saved_kr, block_size=256) once under the original NumPy errstate. Do not call batch_tangent_components_split_numpy, assemble_split_numpy or native_mean, since those would evaluate force or build/assemble a model.

Install small temporary observation wrappers before the attempt: ci.dd_from, ci._pair_mask and ci._finish plus a _tangent_pairs block-context wrapper and a terminal _finish_tangent wrapper. Each invokes its original exactly once and returns the same returned object or raises the original exception; no input mutation, arithmetic replacement, retry, extra DD evaluation or changed support predicate.

Constructor wrapper records the first raw operand that the original dd_from converts to unsupported NaN; pair-mask wrapper records the first false mask returned by the original predicate, including its already-normalized high/low words; finish wrapper records the first newly unsupported result/temporary case and raw high/low/valid arguments. A single first-event NPZ/JSON is saved for each category at most, not an unbounded operation log. Record exact caller/source line and nested primitive chain.

The block wrapper tracks the actual original sequential slices (0:256,...,3072:3200) and returns original pairs unchanged. The terminal wrapper copies all three assembled global DD pairs before delegating once to original _finish_tangent. Do not re-evaluate a block to obtain missing context. The observation may capture an intermediate bad predicate and continue the same one attempt until the original finish raises; observing a false mask is not a new permission to override it.

After the original exception, summarize all three saved complete DD fields with finite/range/normalization masks using plain saved-array predicates and the original literal limits, not another tangent/CI evaluation. Keep original total_tangent-first error authoritative; identify component failures separately without changing original field order. Preserve partial fields if the original attempt exits before the terminal wrapper.

Restore all wrapped same instances in finally and verify restoration plus input/source end hashes. Close the one diagnostic attempt after any unexpected exception or resource stop. No automatic repair, fallback, full-vs-chunk second attempt or repeat is included.

index_and_provenance_rules.direction_and_force_mapping: Local index 2*node+component, node order matches captured edofs/connectivity. Preserve the raw DD index as well as decoded node/component; no symmetrization.
index_and_provenance_rules.cell_mapping: Attach global element = actual block start + local leading element index only when the raw tensor has a known element axis equal to the current block count. Shared 8-direction operator tensors and scalar predicates have no cell axis; mark shared/undetermined instead of guessing an element. Record broadcast operand indices/shapes and global coordinate/connectivity when a cell is known.
index_and_provenance_rules.first_event_caveat: First invalid intermediate may lie in an evaluated branch later selected away; record whether its output survives the observed term/terminal failure. Do not call every first bad intermediate the causal root merely because it is earlier in evaluation order.
index_and_provenance_rules.failure_reasons: Separate original input-valid=false propagation, nonfinite words, nonzero |word|<2^-400, |word|>2^400, normalized-low overlap bound, and nonfinite/|temporary|>2^900. Zeros remain admitted. Record actual values/float hex and raw words; no snapping, widening, threshold clipping or scale changes.

minimal_outputs: result.json with original exception, one-attempt counters, selector context, first observed event references and restoration/end-hash status
first_bad_primitive.npz/json with exact operands/high/low/valid/mask, source stack and block/axis mapping (if observed)
tangent_pairs.npz for total/material/regularization high and low words copied immediately before original finish, or explicitly incomplete/absent if not reached
component_summary.json listing each saved DD field bad counts/first indexed entries under the original predicate; no numerical qualification

proposed_new_window.includes: Imports/hash reads/observer copies/one tangent attempt/output/restoration/end hashes
proposed_new_window.status: Proposed independent card only; no window started by this design
proposed_new_window.first_error_policy: Expected original KernelError may produce observation-complete status only, with tangent completed0 and qualificationfalse. Any other error/no reproduction/resource stop is recorded without retry.

qualification: Observation of the existing rejected T44 input only. Raw DD fields may be unsupported/nonfinite; they do not acquire fresh force/Jv/equilibrium/contact/pressure/energy/stress-HP/all-column qualification. No accepted-path or right-shift task is rerun.
next_decision: Only after this one actual trace identifies a primitive and surviving field/cell may a targeted mathematical repair and its minimal independent qualification be proposed. Do not choose new scaling or revise support gates from Gmax alone.
